name: girls-boys-paradise
description: A Discord community platform with a dashboard, API, bot, and shared D1 database.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @gbp/shared && npm run build --workspace @gbp/api && npm run build --workspace @gbp/bot && npm run build --workspace @gbp/dashboard
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @gbp/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @gbp/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @gbp/bot && npm run typecheck --workspace @gbp/dashboard && npm run typecheck --workspace @gbp/database
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply gbp-community --local --config apps/api/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply gbp-community --remote --config apps/api/wrangler.jsonc
